def add_case_participants(
    case: Case,
    participant_emails: list[str],
    db_session: Session,
):
    """Adds one or more participants to the case conversation."""
    if not case.conversation:
        log.warning(
            "Case participant(s) not added to conversation. No conversation available for this case."
        )
        return

    plugin = plugin_service.get_active_instance(
        db_session=db_session, project_id=case.project.id, plugin_type="conversation"
    )
    if not plugin:
        log.warning(
            "Case participant(s) not added to conversation. No conversation plugin enabled."
        )
        return

    try:
        if case.has_thread:
            if case.signal_instances:
                if case.signal_instances[0].signal.lifecycle == "production":
                    # we only add participants to case threads that originate from signals in production
                    plugin.instance.add_to_thread(
                        case.conversation.channel_id,
                        case.conversation.thread_id,
                        participant_emails,
                    )

                    # log event for adding participants
                    event_service.log_case_event(
                        db_session=db_session,
                        source=plugin.plugin.title,
                        description=f"{', '.join(participant_emails)} added to conversation (channel ID: {case.conversation.channel_id}, thread ID: {case.conversation.thread_id})",
                        case_id=case.id,
                        type=EventType.participant_updated,
                    )
                    log.info(f"{', '.join(participant_emails)} added to conversation (channel ID: {case.conversation.channel_id}, thread ID: {case.conversation.thread_id})")
        elif case.has_channel:
            plugin.instance.add(case.conversation.channel_id, participant_emails)

            # log event for adding participants
            event_service.log_case_event(
                db_session=db_session,
                source=plugin.plugin.title,
                description=f"{', '.join(participant_emails)} added to conversation (channel ID: {case.conversation.channel_id})",
                case_id=case.id,
                type=EventType.participant_updated,
            )
            log.info(f"{', '.join(participant_emails)} added to conversation (channel ID: {case.conversation.channel_id})")
    except Exception as e:
        event_service.log_case_event(
            db_session=db_session,
            source="Dispatch Core App",
            description=f"Adding participant(s) to case conversation failed. Reason: {e}",
            case_id=case.id,
        )
        log.exception(e)
        raise e

94	    if service_id:
95	        # we need to ensure that we don't add another member of a service if one
96	        # already exists (e.g. overlapping oncalls, we assume they will hand-off if necessary)
97	        participant = participant_service.get_by_case_id_and_service_id(
98	            case_id=case_id, service_id=service_id, db_session=db_session

100

106	        db_session=db_session, case_id=case.id, email=user_email
107	    )

109	        if participant.active_roles:

116	            )

content.text:
The function is `add_case_participants` in `src/dispatch/conversation/flows.py`. It only adds people to a thread when the case has a thread and its first linked signal's definition is in the `production` lifecycle.

- **Hand-opened cases:** No. The thread branch requires `case.signal_instances`, and a case opened by hand has none, so nobody is added to the thread. If the case has a dedicated channel instead, the person is added to the channel.
- **Alert-raised cases:** The alert's signal definition must have `lifecycle` set to `"production"`. The check reads `case.signal_instances[0].signal.lifecycle == "production"`, and `lifecycle` is a plain string column on the signal model (`src/dispatch/signal/models.py:139`). Any other value, including unset, means no one is added.

I changed nothing.
